function.name: chest_xray_report_generator
function.description: A tool that analyzes chest X-ray images and generates comprehensive radiology reports containing both detailed findings and impression summaries. function.name: chest_xray_segmentation
function.description: Segments chest X-ray images to specified anatomical structures. function.name: chest_xray_expert

function.name: llava_med_qa

function.name: xray_phrase_grounding

function.name: image_visualizer
